name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: Short helper text built on the Popover API, shown when the trigger is hovered or focused.

props.name: side
props.description: Side of the trigger to show the tooltip on. Flips to the other side when it does not fit on screen.

props.name: children / slot
props.description: A single focusable trigger element, such as a button.

props.name: id
props.description: Tooltip element id, used for the trigger aria-describedby.

a11y: Uses role=tooltip, and the trigger automatically gets aria-describedby pointing to the tooltip.
Shows when the trigger receives keyboard focus and on hover (300ms delay).
Escape, blur, or moving the mouse away hides the tooltip.

ai.whenToUse: Explaining an icon button or a short action whose label is not clear enough.
rules: Tooltip content is short text only, never links or buttons
The trigger must be a single focusable element
Never keep important information only in a tooltip

id.description: Teks bantuan singkat berbasis Popover API yang muncul saat pemicu di-hover atau difokus.

props.side: Sisi tooltip terhadap pemicu. Pindah ke sisi lain kalau tidak muat di layar.
props.children / slot: Satu elemen pemicu yang bisa difokus, misalnya tombol.
props.id: Id elemen tooltip, dipakai untuk aria-describedby pemicu.

a11y: Memakai role=tooltip dan pemicu otomatis diberi aria-describedby ke tooltip.
Muncul saat pemicu difokus dengan keyboard dan saat di-hover (jeda 300ms).
Escape, blur, atau mouse keluar menyembunyikan tooltip.

ai.whenToUse: Menjelaskan tombol ikon atau aksi singkat yang labelnya kurang jelas.
rules: Isi tooltip hanya teks pendek, jangan link atau tombol
Pemicu harus satu elemen yang bisa difokus
Jangan menyimpan informasi penting hanya di tooltip
